mapper.sql: SELECT relation.*, source_table.table_name AS source_table_name, target_table.table_name AS target_table_name FROM logical_table_relation relation INNER JOIN table_info source_table ON source_table.id = relation.source_table_id INNER JOIN table_info target_table ON target_table.id = relation.target_table_id
mapper.select: WHERE relation.datasource_id = #{datasourceId} ORDER BY relation.create_time DESC, relation.id DESC

LOWER(#{sourceTableName})
ORDER BY relation.id DESC
